description:
T13 Oak, Section fell to ground level and grind stump.
Is on boundary to west of wall. Has significant
dysfunction in canopy. Stem has multiple lesions around
it at base. Large dead sect of bark tapped to north at
base. Behind bark is intense white rot. Tar spotting in
bark above it to 1.4m. Cavity detected at base to west.
Probed to 300mm of 710mm with very poor adaptive
growth. Has excess root flare. Of extremely limited
landscape contribution

T14 Lombardy Poplar, Section fell to ground level and grind stump. The tree has a significant lean towards the school next door and is within striking distance.
Has been recently pollarded at current height. Has a
comprehensive cavity with associated decay. Probed to
450mm of 1250mm with no resistance. Of very limited
landscape contribution.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions:
There is a duty under the planning acts to replace any tree removed if the tree was subject to a Tree Preservation Order (TPO) or growing within a Conservation Area and was removed due to being dead or dangerous, or if the tree has been removed under exemption.  

We would be grateful if you would advise us of your arrangements for replacing the tree to be removed with details of the tree species, size at planting time and intended time of replacement so that we can assess the suitability and timing of the planting.
